source.file: Archives of the Empire - Volume III.pdf

summary: Prayers, Hedgecraft & Skill choices · no new foundations

included: 18 previously reviewed Miracles: Handrich, Solkan and Rhya (pp. 47, 55, 74).
Nine new Hedgecraft spell names (pp. 62–64), including seven explicit Fellstave targets.
Handrich/Solkan/Old Faith patrons and their printed Blessing options; Old Faith Invoke learns Blessings, not invented Miracles.
Existing Language (Belthani), Lore (Torture) and Fearless (Magic Users) choices.
excluded: Six named NPC stat blocks on pp. 30, 90, 92–94.
Six animal-familiar profiles on pp. 76–78 and familiar creation/progression/bonding: deferred by prior user decision.
Alternative armour (pp. 34–38): excluded by prior user decision.
Career development, hirelings, Enterprises, live Channelling/power/Conditions, prices or bonuses invented from descriptive text.
decisions: Reuse the approved PC book pack; no duplicate equipment, Talent or spell definitions.
GM spell selection is explicit without PC starting allocations, XP purchases or automatic six/one prayer grants.
All 24 Cants remain reference-only in GM creation pending the explicit Arcane spell Lore-assignment decision. PC Cant selection is unchanged.
